固元丹？大长老睁大双眼。他对于此物并不陌生，乃是黄阶极品丹药，价值不菲。即便是花费姜家大量资产，也购买不多。其作用也是神效无比，一旦服用，可以加快伤势恢复速度，并稳固根基。当年，姜道玄闭关之前，便曾花费大代价购买了一枚。“谢谢族长恩赐。”大长老激动不已，颤巍巍伸出双手，小心翼翼接过丹药，捧到掌心。紧接着，一口吞下，咽入腹中。不多时，他脸上的煞白之色，开始以肉眼可见速度褪去，脸色迅速红润起来。嗯，不错，挺贴心。姜道玄点了点头，旋即看向大长老，徐徐说道。“距离我闭关之时，已过多久？这些时日里，又发生了何事”刚刚利用紫府神识探查到院内危机后，他这才加急赶来。却不知里面究竟是何缘故。听到自家族长发话，大长老立即收起内心的喜悦，回想近日遭遇，娓娓道来。“回禀族长，自从您闭关至今已六年有余，这些年来，因为您闭关的消息已经传开，许多人都都猜测您突破失败死了，所以唐家越来越肆无忌惮，开始抢占我姜家田地，引起各种争斗，只为测试您是否还在。”“数年已过，眼看您一直不曾出现，唐家彻底没了顾忌，开始联合孙家与高家，大肆占我姜家矿脉田地，在城内我们家的商铺酒楼捣乱，搞得许多客人抱怨，令我们失去许多市场份额，环境愈加窘迫。”“不过，在两年前，我们与唐家爆发了一次剧烈冲突，您的族弟道灵死在了唐家人手中。”“之后，道灵的儿子姜辰展露修炼天赋，我族卖掉数间商铺酒楼，将族中三成资产换成财物，以此为由打通关系，令姜辰得以加入千山宗，成为内门弟子。”“在得到千山宗的庇护后，这才令唐家、孙家、高家的动作收敛许多。”“只是，这唐家不知道从哪里得来的消息，说是姜辰在执行宗门任务途中，遭遇落枫宗袭击，如今已是丹田破碎，被千山宗逐出宗门，这才令唐家失去忌惮，由唐正阳亲自带领族人找上门来，欲要在今日覆灭我族”闻言，姜道玄眼中若有所思，脸色逐渐奇怪起来。唐、孙、高三大家族的动作，倒是没有出乎他的预料。只是这姜辰的经历，不知为何，总令他有种似曾相识的熟悉感。曾经是家族天才，加入宗门，执行宗门任务，被敌对宗门偷袭，丹田破碎，被逐出宗门该不会是姜道玄摇了摇头。这等大因果，怎么可能落到姜家？不都是什么叶、林、萧、苏等等家族？连忙将想法抛之脑后，姜道玄开始起思索下一步动作。既然已经将唐家众人击杀，彻底与唐家撕破脸皮，那么不如化被动为主动，选择先下手为强？卧榻之下，岂容他人鼾睡？必须要将危险扼杀于摇篮之中，将唐家的鸡蛋都要摇散黄，蚂蚁窝都得浇开水，一个人都不能漏网！正当姜道玄逐渐打定主意，眼露杀机之时。家族任务？姜道玄内心一喜。很好，系统任务正合我意。这下唐家真是不死绝都不行了！姜道玄冷笑一声，抬头望向众人。“唐家如此肆意妄为，我姜家如何能忍？此等大仇，势必要以鲜血洗清！尔等，可愿随本族长前往唐家，令其血债血偿，讨回公道？！”话音响彻整个大院，令在场众人先是一愣。但紧接着，待反应过来，他们面露兴奋，振臂高呼，发出震天动地的巨响！“我大哥与二叔便是死在唐家手中！此等血仇唯有唐家覆灭方能化解！”“如今，有族长替我等做主，我等自愿前往！”“唐家这般欺我姜家，当真是可忍孰不可忍！此番定要讨回公道！”“哈哈哈！族长已修成紫府上境，而唐家老祖则是垂垂老矣，区区唐家，又有何惧？怕是不堪一击！”这一刻，所有姜家子弟都紧握双拳，心神激荡。大长老望着这一幕，瞳孔深处仿佛有火焰升腾。“唐家欠我姜家的账，如今是时候该找回来了”将众人表现尽收眼底，姜道玄满意点了点头，旋即面向众人，沉声道。“出发！”话音落下，姜道玄立即转身，朝姜家大门方向走去。见此，所有人紧跟其后，形成一条长龙队形。很快，姜道玄便已经抵达姜府大门口。正当前脚迈出之时。姜道玄忽然神色微愣，动作一滞。这令身后众人也不由停下脚步，有些不明所以。而令姜道玄停下前进的原因很简单。因为系统的提示出现了。金色等级？姜道玄惊讶到了。要知道即便是身为先天境七重的大长老，也不过被系统判定为绿色等级。而如今，这一位突然冒出来的金色等级族人，又该有多夸张？带着好奇，姜道玄环顾四周，根据系统指引，很快便发现了目标。在百米开外的街道上，正有一位身穿破旧灰衣，体格消瘦，头发杂乱，面色苍白的落魄少年。他走路摇摇晃晃，就好像随时都有可能跌倒在地。此刻，少年正举步维艰地朝姜家而来。这人是？姜道玄眉头一皱，眼中带有疑惑。根据记忆里的画面，他并未见识过这副陌生面孔。不过疑惑才刚刚升起。下一刻，四周的姜家族人顺着自家族长目光看去，发现了那位少年。定睛一看，不由失声道。“姜辰？是姜辰回来了！”“还真是姜辰，只是此番为何如此落魄模样？难道那唐正阳所言非虚，姜辰真被逐出千山宗了？”“这千山宗真是欺人太甚！姜辰才多大年纪？便被这般逐出，恐怕要是再回来晚一些，就该饿死街头了吧？”“千山宗距离邬旦城这么远，难道，他就是这么一路徒步走回来的？”众位姜家子弟议论纷纷，尽皆面露愤怒，为姜辰的遭遇打抱不平。姜家子弟同气连枝，岂能容许外人这般践踏自家族人？

Guyuan Dan? The great elder opened his eyes wide. He is no stranger to this item. It is a top-quality elixir from the Huang class and is worth a lot of money. Even if the Jiang family spent a lot of assets, they would not buy much. Its effect is also extremely effective. Once taken, it can speed up the recovery of injuries and stabilize the foundation. Back then, before Jiang Daoxuan went into seclusion, he spent a lot of money to buy one. "Thank you, Patriarch, for the gift." The elder was very excited. He stretched out his hands tremblingly, carefully took the elixir, and held it in his palm. Then, swallow it in one gulp and swallow it into your belly. Not long after, the pale color on his face began to fade away at a speed visible to the naked eye, and his face quickly turned rosy. Well, not bad, quite considerate. Jiang Daoxuan nodded, then looked at the great elder and said slowly. "How long has it been since I went into seclusion? What happened during these days?" He hurried over after he had just used Zi Mansion's spiritual sense to detect the crisis in the hospital. But I don’t know what’s going on inside. After hearing the words from the head of his family, the great elder immediately put away his inner joy, recalled his recent experiences, and spoke eloquently. "Reporting to the patriarch, it has been more than six years since you went into seclusion. Over the years, because the news of your seclusion has spread, many people have speculated that you failed to break through and died. Therefore, the Tang family has become more and more unscrupulous and began to seize my Jiang family's land, causing various fights, just to test whether you are still there." "Several years have passed, and I see that you have never appeared. Tang The family completely lost their scruples and began to unite with the Sun family and the Gao family to occupy our Jiang family's mineral fields and cause trouble in our shops and restaurants in the city, causing many customers to complain. We lost a lot of market share and the environment became more embarrassing. ""However, two years ago, we had a violent conflict with the Tang family, and your brother Dao Ling died at the hands of the Tang family. "Afterwards, Dao Ling's son Jiang Chen showed his talent for cultivation. Our family sold several shops and restaurants and exchanged 30% of the family's assets for property. This allowed Jiang Chen to join the Qianshan Sect and become an inner disciple." The family didn’t know where they got the news, saying that Jiang Chen was attacked by the Luofeng Sect while on his way to perform the sect’s mission. Now his Dantian was shattered and he was expelled from the sect by the Qianshan Sect. This made the Tang family lose their fear. Tang Zhengyang personally led the clan to come to the door, intending to destroy our clan today.” Hearing this, Jiang Daoxuan’s eyes were thoughtful, and his face gradually became strange. The actions of the Tang, Sun, and Gao families did not exceed his expectations. It's just that Jiang Chen's experience, for some reason, always made him feel familiar. Once a family genius, he joined the sect and performed sect tasks. He was attacked by a hostile sect, his Dantian was shattered, and he was expelled from the sect. Jiang Daoxuan shook his head. How could such a big cause and effect happen to the Jiang family? Aren’t they all from the Ye, Lin, Xiao, Su, etc. families? Quickly throwing the thought away, Jiang Daoxuan began to think about his next move. Now that everyone in the Tang family has been killed and completely separated from the Tang family, why not change from passive to active and choose to strike first? How can you allow others to snore and sleep under the couch? The danger must be nipped in the cradle, all the eggs of the Tang family must be shaken until they are yellow, and all the ant nests must be poured with boiling water, so that no one can slip through the net! Just when Jiang Daoxuan gradually made up his mind, murderous intent appeared in his eyes. Family mission? Jiang Daoxuan was happy in his heart. Great, the system tasks are just what I want. Now the Tang family really has no choice but to die! Jiang Daoxuan sneered and looked up at everyone. "How can the Jiang family tolerate such wanton behavior of the Tang family? Such a great hatred must be washed away with blood! Are you willing to follow the leader of the clan to the Tang family to make him pay for his blood debt and seek justice?!" The words resounded through the entire courtyard, making everyone present stunned for a moment. But then, when they reacted, they looked excited, raised their arms and shouted, making a shocking noise.A loud noise that shook the heavens and the earth! "My eldest brother and second uncle died at the hands of the Tang family! This kind of blood feud can only be resolved by the destruction of the Tang family!" "Now, there is a clan leader who makes the decision for us, so we go voluntarily!" "It is really unbearable for the Tang family to bully my Jiang family like this! This is really unbearable! We must seek justice!" "Hahaha! The clan leader has reached the upper realm of the Purple Mansion, and the ancestor of the Tang family is old. What is there to fear? I am afraid that he will be vulnerable!" At this moment, all the children of the Jiang family clenched their fists and were excited. The great elder looked at this scene, and there seemed to be flames rising from the depths of his pupils. "The Tang family owes me the debt of the Jiang family, and now it's time to get it back." Jiang Daoxuan nodded with satisfaction after seeing everyone's performance, and then faced everyone and said in a deep voice. "Let's go!" After the words fell, Jiang Daoxuan immediately turned around and walked towards the Jiang family gate. Seeing this, everyone followed closely, forming a long queue. Soon, Jiang Daoxuan arrived at the gate of Jiang Mansion. Just when the front foot steps forward. Jiang Daoxuan suddenly looked stunned and his movements stagnated. This caused everyone behind him to stop and feel a little confused. The reason why Jiang Daoxuan stopped moving forward was simple. Because the system prompt appears. Gold level? Jiang Daoxuan was surprised. You must know that even the Great Elder, who is at the seventh level of the Xiantian Realm, is only judged to be at the green level by the system. And now, how exaggerated is this golden-level tribesman who suddenly appears? With curiosity, Jiang Daoxuan looked around and quickly found the target according to the system guidance. On the street a hundred meters away, there was a down-and-out young man wearing shabby gray clothes, with a thin build, messy hair, and a pale complexion. He walked unsteadily, as if he might fall to the ground at any moment. At this moment, the young man was walking towards Jiang's house with great difficulty. Who is this person? Jiang Daoxuan frowned, with doubts in his eyes. According to the scene in his memory, he had never seen this unfamiliar face before. But doubts were just beginning to arise. The next moment, the surrounding Jiang family members followed the gaze of their family leader and spotted the young man. After taking a closer look, he couldn't help but lost his voice. "Jiang Chen? It's Jiang Chen who's back!" "It's really Jiang Chen, but why is he so downcast this time? Could it be that what Tang Zhengyang said was true, and Jiang Chen was really expelled from the Qianshan Sect?" "This Qianshan Sect is really deceiving people! How old is Jiang Chen? He was expelled like this. , I'm afraid if I come back later, I'll starve to death on the street, right?" "Qianshan Sect is so far away from Wudan City, is this how he walked all the way back?" All the Jiang family disciples talked about it, all with angry expressions on their faces, complaining about Jiang Chen's experience. The children of the Jiang family are all in the same spirit, how can they allow outsiders to trample on their own family members like this?
